content: अक्षि {%n.%} [अश्नुते विषयान्; अश्-क्सि, अशेर्णित् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 155-6</ls>] अक्षिणी अक्षीणि, अक्ष्णा, अक्ष्णः <ab>&c.</ab> .²1 The eye (which grasps or sees objects); changed to अक्ष at the end of Bahuvrīhi <ab>comp.</ab>; {%f.%} ˚क्षी when a limb of the body is indicated, as जलजाक्षी, otherwise दीर्घाक्षा वेणुयष्टिः; in <ab>Avyayī. comp.</ab> also it is changed to अक्ष, (समक्षम्, परोक्षम् <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 The number two; (-क्षिणी) the sun and moon. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%oculus%}; <lang>Ger.</lang> {%auge%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%okos, okkos%}, <lang>Zend.</lang> {%ashi%}.]
